sources.said: 2. (1) The days mentioned in the Schedule shall be observed throughout Zambia as public holidays. sources.title: National Assembly of Zambia, Report of the Committee on Governance, Housing and Chiefs' Affairs on the Public Holidays (Amendment) Bill, N.A.B. No. 76 of 2026
sources.said: Zambia currently observes sixteen public holidays annually ... under section 3 of the principal Act, the Minister retains powers to declare additional public holidays by statutory notice. These include International Women's Day, Kenneth Kaunda Day, Easter Monday and the National Day of Prayer, Fasting, Repentance and Reconciliation. ... the "Sunday rule" practically applies to eight (8) holidays.

sources.title: News Diggers, Govt, churches move National Day of Prayer to Dec 29 (9 October 2026)
sources.said: GOVERNMENT, in agreement with the Church Mother Bodies, has moved the National Day of Prayer from October 18, to December 29.

sources.title: News Diggers, Moving National Day of Prayer to Dec 29 is "satanic betrayal" - Sumaili (10 October 2026)
sources.said: In 2015, late former president Edgar Lungu declared October 18 as an annual public holiday to observe the National Day of Prayer, Fasting, Repentance and Reconciliation.

sources.title: News Diggers, Only Thursday is a public holiday, govt tells workers (11 August 2026)
sources.said: Kangwa says government has declared Thursday, August 13, as a public holiday to allow workers to cast their votes.

sources.title: News Diggers, Cabinet declares inauguration day a holiday (31 August 2026)
sources.said: GOVERNMENT has declared Tuesday, September 1st, a public holiday. This is the day of inauguration for President-elect Hakainde Hichilema
